title: VNS (VIT-AP Name Services)
tagline: Your Immortal API on the blockchain!
description:
People are living under centralized agencies now. Especially students, under the university's centralization. Standard rules are acceptable, but there are many things I personally saw that management is taking as granted. This exploits students' fundamental rules. It restricts students from complaining securely to exploring different fields. A fully developed version of this dApp:
1) secures the fundamental rights that the college provides as those rights and the consequences when they're being exploited are totally governed by smart contracts.
2) Ex: I paid an excess amount once as a fee for my university. They agreed to return it back but to the virtual bank account(excess basket). That means I can just use it for the university fee. Nothing more! This smart contract code automatically returns it to the student's bank account, so that it can be used for different purposes.
3) UPI payments can be easily replaced with crypto payments as the person-specific domain names make them easier to identify a person with his "Registration number".
4) Personal websites can also be built on top of these domain names as a single-shot spot for all the student's essential links. An NFT will also be provided by the university as a token of assurance for that particular student. 
5) University will have a record of each and every change that's going into a student's record, which might/might not be achieved through traditional database systems. + Infinite space to store records.
6) An all-in-one website which connects all the domain records that are generated through a particular TLD ( college name in this case), acts as a common communication forum for the university students, which when gone in-depth can have many use cases. Ex: Hostel channels, specific issue-related temporary solving pages, information pages In short, a decentralized discord can be integrated/built on top of it. 
It has infinite use cases, which can be found with the help of deep research.

solution: well, it takes time. But, attention is required to give attention to the detail in code. Yes! that's how it works.
